params.message:
The policy is a person's row: exposure:csp beside exposure:headers

Elixir judges the content security policy apart from the safe set
(elixir#196), so the worklist hands them to different places: the safe set
to the headers playbook, the policy to a person, with its own chip. A site
where the hand has set everything it can now has no row with the hand's
name on it, which is what portal looked like all afternoon: a button that
answered "a human's call" every time.
